verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires independently created testimonial material because existing customer reviews are not available in a usable recorded format, establishing the creative-source behavior and task-local scope.
The freelancer explicitly commits to the client-originated testimonial-style presentation, defining the creative format of the testimonial material.

This is a target-specific implementation claim that the concept was rebuilt as a testimonial-style UGC execution featuring multiple Indian testimonials; it does not claim runtime verification or completed scene production.
